published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: If the bankruptcy time of the target bucket is greater than the deposit time of the source location, the liquidity provider's funds will be permanently frozen.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Update the depositTime of the target position to the latest valid deposit time of that position.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The depositTime of the target position is set directly to the depositTime of the source position.

    93 |     /**
    94 |      *  @dev   Modifier used to check if sender can interact with token id.
    95 |      *  @param pool_    `Ajna` pool address.
    96 |      *  @param tokenId_ Id of positions `NFT`.
    97 |      */
    98 |     modifier mayInteract(address pool_, uint256 tokenId_) {
    99 | 
   100 |         // revert if token id is not a valid / minted id
   101 |         _requireMinted(tokenId_);
   102 | 
   103 |         // revert if sender is not owner of or entitled to operate on token id
   104 |         if (!_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId_)) revert NoAuth();
   105 | 
   106 |         // revert if the token id is not minted for given pool address
   107 |         if (pool_ != poolKey[tokenId_]) revert WrongPool();
   108 | 
   109 |         _;
   110 |     }

    25 |     @notice External library containing logic for lender actors:
    26 |             - `Lenders`: add, remove and move quote tokens;
    27 |             - `Traders`: add, remove and move quote tokens; add and remove collateral
    28 |  */
    29 | library LenderActions {
    30 | 
    31 |     /*************************/
    32 |     /*** Local Var Structs ***/
    33 |     /*************************/
    34 | 
    35 |     /// @dev Struct used for `moveQuoteToken` function local vars.
    36 |     struct MoveQuoteLocalVars {
    37 |         uint256 fromBucketPrice;            // [WAD] Price of the bucket to move amount from.
    38 |         uint256 fromBucketCollateral;       // [WAD] Total amount of collateral in from bucket.
    39 |         uint256 fromBucketLP;               // [WAD] Total amount of LP in from bucket.
    40 |         uint256 fromBucketLenderLP;         // [WAD] Amount of LP owned by lender in from bucket.
    41 |         uint256 fromBucketDepositTime;      // Time of lender deposit in the bucket to move amount from.
    42 |         uint256 fromBucketRemainingLP;      // Amount of LP remaining in from bucket after move.
    43 |         uint256 fromBucketRemainingDeposit; // Amount of scaled deposit remaining in from bucket after move.
    44 |         uint256 toBucketPrice;              // [WAD] Price of the bucket to move amount to.
    45 |         uint256 toBucketBankruptcyTime;     // Time the bucket to move amount to was marked as insolvent.
    46 |         uint256 toBucketDepositTime;        // Time of lender deposit in the bucket to move amount to.
    47 |         uint256 toBucketUnscaledDeposit;    // Amount of unscaled deposit in to bucket.
    48 |         uint256 toBucketDeposit;            // Amount of scaled deposit in to bucket.
    49 |         uint256 toBucketScale;              // Scale deposit of to bucket.
    50 |         uint256 ptp;                        // [WAD] Pool Threshold Price.
    51 |         uint256 htp;                        // [WAD] Highest Threshold Price.
    52 |     }
    53 | 
    54 |     /// @dev Struct used for `removeQuoteToken` function local vars.
    55 |     struct RemoveDepositParams {
    56 |         uint256 depositConstraint; // [WAD] Constraint on deposit in quote token.
    57 |         uint256 lpConstraint;      // [WAD] Constraint in LPB terms.
    58 |         uint256 bucketLP;          // [WAD] Total LPB in the bucket.
    59 |         uint256 bucketCollateral;  // [WAD] Claimable collateral in the bucket.
    60 |         uint256 price;             // [WAD] Price of bucket.
    61 |         uint256 index;             // Bucket index.
    62 |         uint256 dustLimit;         // Minimum amount of deposit which may reside in a bucket.
    63 |     }
